description: List managed assets in the open site with whole-project usage counts. References are checked across every page, shared symbols, styles, and site settings. Use imagesOnly:true and unusedOnly:true before deleting unused gallery images.

imagesOnly.description: Return only image MIME types. Default false.

unusedOnly.description: Return only assets with no references anywhere in the project. Default false.

name: swebsy_list_assets
